description: Enable or disable a RouterOS IP service (api, api-ssl, ssh, telnet, www, www-ssl, winbox, ftp). Port number changes are intentionally not supported to prevent accidental lockout.

action.description: Action to perform — only enable/disable to prevent accidental lockout from changing ports

confirmationToken.description: Token from a prior APPROVAL_REQUIRED response. Re-submit the identical call with this token to confirm the destructive action.

name.description: Service name to manage (api, api-ssl, ssh, telnet, www, www-ssl, winbox, ftp)

routerId.description: Router ID; omit to use the default router.

name: manage_ip_service
title: Manage IP Service
